extracted.intended_audience: USC faculty, postdocs, and research administrators looking for internal and external research funding
extracted.subtask_description: A university web page listing internal and external funding sources and procedural notes for locating, submitting, or updating research funding opportunities at USC.

rubrics_metrics.name: COVID-19-specific funding referral
rubrics_metrics.description: For COVID-19-specific funding, please visit the COVID-19 Research Continuity section of our website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If your project is COVID-19-related, consult the dedicated Research Continuity section rather than the general list to find targeted opportunities and guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: OORI-managed programs and limited submissions referral
rubrics_metrics.description: For funding programs or limited submissions managed by OORI, please visit Research Initiatives and Infrastructure (RII).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Directed referral: use the RII page for programs that OORI manages or that have limited-submission rules rather than the general funding table.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adding or updating funding opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: To add or update a funding opportunity below, please fill out our Funding Opportunities Form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural requirement for contributors/administrators: use the specified form to submit new entries or corrections to the funding list.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Philanthropy News Digest as an RFP source
rubrics_metrics.description: Philanthropy News Digest publishes RFPs and notices of awards as a free service for U.S.-based nonprofit and grantmaking organizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Suggested external resource for discovering RFPs and notices; note the geographic/organizational focus (U.S.-based nonprofits and grantmakers).

rubrics_metrics.name: Responsibility to confirm award deadlines and details
rubrics_metrics.description: It is your responsibility to confirm the award deadline and other details by following the links to the RFP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page provides a convenience table that may be outdated; always follow the primary RFP link to verify current deadlines, eligibility, award amounts, and submission instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table may contain outdated information (caveat)
rubrics_metrics.description: The table below is provided for your convenience as a resource in your search for internal funding and may contain outdated information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat the listing as an index only; verify all substantive details on the original RFP pages before acting.
